en-US.title: Dishr — Social Cookbook
en-US.subtitle: Save, cook, log and share
en-US.description:
Dishr turns the recipes you find into recipes you actually cook.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
Paste a link — or share straight from your browser, TikTok, or Instagram — and Dishr extracts the ingredients and steps into a clean, cookable recipe. No more screenshots you never open again.

COOK MODE
A full-screen, step-by-step view built for messy hands: big type, one step at a time, ingredient checklist, and your screen stays awake the whole time.

LOG YOUR TRIES
Every time you cook something, log it: rate it out of 10, add notes and photos, and build a history of what you've made. Watch your favorites — and your skills — improve over time.

COOK WITH YOUR FRIDGE
Tell Dishr what ingredients you have and it finds recipes you can make right now.

A FEED OF REAL COOKING
Follow friends and other home cooks. See what they're actually making — real tries, real ratings, real photos — not staged food photography. Like, save, and message recipes to friends.

YOUR TASTE, YOUR FEED
A quick palate quiz tunes discovery to what you love, and your recommendations get smarter as you log more tries.

ORGANIZE YOUR KITCHEN
Collect recipes into albums, keep drafts, save what looks good, and find it all again instantly.

Cooking is better together. Dishr is where your recipes — and your people — live.
